purpose: Machine-readable licensing boundaries for OFU. This manifest classifies policy scope; it does not itself relicense any path that lacks an explicit applicable license notice.

classes.description: Canonical OFU implementation, runtime, simulation, rendering, build and product code unless a narrower explicit notice says otherwise.
Public protocols, schemas and interoperability specifications may be made permissive by an explicit future R5 path-level decision.
SDK/client libraries intended to maximize ecosystem adoption may be made permissive only by an explicit future R5 path-level decision.
Community/user documentation may receive a documentation-specific license in a future explicit migration; current default licensing is not changed by this manifest.
A future network-centric OFU server may warrant AGPL. No present OFU path is relicensed to AGPL by this policy.
Scientific datasets retain their own provenance and licensing; public availability is never treated as redistribution permission.
Third-party code, fonts, media, assets and models retain explicit upstream licensing and notice requirements.
OFU does not claim ownership merely because ordinary user-created output or scientific results were produced with OFU.
